# Bamboo Flags

> Bamboo Flags builds custom automation, AI solutions, process optimization and web development for growing businesses. Work starts with a free 45-minute call. The site is in English, with German (https://bambooflags.com/de/) and Italian (https://bambooflags.com/it/) versions.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://bambooflags.com/): Bamboo Flags builds custom automation and AI solutions for growing businesses. Book a free 45-minute call.
- [About](https://bambooflags.com/about.html): Flexible like bamboo, clear like a flag. How Bamboo Flags builds automation for growing businesses, and the values we hold to on every project.
- [Blog](https://bambooflags.com/blog.html): Daily articles on AI, automation, security and the web.
- [Careers](https://bambooflags.com/careers.html): No current openings at Bamboo Flags. Send a spontaneous application.

## Services
- [Web Development](https://bambooflags.com/web-development.html): Websites, portals and internal tools built to connect with the systems you already use — not a brochure that sits on its own.
- [Process Optimization](https://bambooflags.com/process-optimization.html): We map how work actually moves through your team, find the steps that cost time, and redesign the process before anything is built.
- [Automation Services](https://bambooflags.com/automation.html): Data entry, handovers, reminders and reports handed to systems that run every time, with clear logs when something needs a person.
- [AI Solutions](https://bambooflags.com/ai-solutions.html): AI applied to specific tasks — reading documents, drafting replies, sorting requests — with people kept in the loop where it matters.

- [PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability: what to check on your website](https://bambooflags.com/blog/php2shell-php-vulnerability.html): On 21 October 2026 PHP fixed two critical flaws that let attackers run code on web servers. This article lists the facts, who must patch, and the checks to do.

This article lists who blocks agents and why, what is not known, and the checks to do on your automations and on your own website.

- [Apple will tighten Full Disk Access on the Mac: what the permission exposes and what to check](https://bambooflags.com/blog/apple-full-disk-access-ai-agents.html): On 2 October 2026 Apple told developers that it will add controls to the macOS Full Disk Access permission because of AI agents.
